data.rationale: The proposal matches the true workflow's three steps in order (Experience, Baggage allowance, cabin class link) and uses the right cabin_class parameter; it loses a point on feasibility only because the last step says "the cabin class link" without saying that cabin_class picks which link to click (e.g. Economy Class).
